critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/admin/users/{id} cascades to user_state + payment_transactions but NOT to login_attempts (orphaned login-attempt rows for deleted email could accumulate). Low priority — these eventually expire by window=15min in your brute-force gate, but consider db.login_attempts.delete_many({'identifier': target['email']}) for cleanliness.

Same 'last admin' guard concern from iter 11 is also relevant for DELETE — currently nothing prevents the only admin from being deleted by another admin. Consider adding: 'if target.role==admin and (await db.users.count_documents({role:admin}))<=1: 400'. Not exploitable today (only Isaac).

QuickFire 'time-up-up' end-screen could not be exercised end-to-end because the run requires a 60s timer expiry; consider exposing a dev-only ?duration=2 query param or accepting a custom duration in QuickFire start payload to make this testable in CI.

Streak/Boss/Daily input-mode default appears to come from server-side user_state for Isaac (was 'choices' on this account, requiring a manual PUT /api/user/state to flip to 'type' before typed-mode tests could run). The default in /lib/storage.js is 'type'; consider seeding new users with type by also flushing server state on register — or centralising default in a single place.

/play page rendered blank when navigated directly via page.goto('/play') in a fresh tab — possible race during initial state hydration / op-picker only mounts when state exists. Not reproducible from normal in-app navigation, but worth a defensive null-check on getState() return inside OpPicker.jsx.
